input.title: Non-US market to shorten stock settlement to T+1 in 2028
input.summary: A non-US market (source outlet is Korean: 아시아경제) is reported to be shortening its stock settlement cycle to T+1 in 2028, with sellers to receive proceeds the next day. No link to US markets, DTCC, NSCC or DTC is stated in the article.
evidence_quotes: Stock Settlement Cycle to Be Shortened to 'T+1' in 2028... Sellers to Receive Proceeds the Next Day
input.notes: headline_only. Outlet is Korean (아시아경제), suggesting this refers to the South Korean market, not US markets. No link to US markets, DTCC, NSCC or DTC is stated. Geography set to non_us. ECS-SET-01 is technically a match for settlement cycle changes but the card scope note specifies US cash equities settling at NSCC/DTC; relevance is marginal. Reach set to 0 (single non-US market). Effect date of 2028-01-01 is approximate as no specific date is given in the headline.
